1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.c3 Nf6 4.e5 Nd5 5.d4.strategy: Supports the e5-pawn and builds the centre, challenging the c5-pawn at the same time. White gains space and a firm hold on the centre, and Black has to attack the pawn chain to make use of the central knight.

Piles pressure on the base of White's chain: d4 is attacked twice, by the c5-pawn and the knight, and e5 once. Black fights the pawn centre with development, and White must keep the pieces coordinated to hold d4 and e5.
1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.c3 Nf6 4.e5 Nd5 5.d4.name: Sicilian Defence: Alapin Variation, Sherzer Variation
